name: io.github.hcngdanh/m365-attachment-reader-mcp-local
description: Local stdio MCP server for Claude Desktop that reads Outlook emails and parses attachments (PDF/OCR/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/images/archives/MSG) via Microsoft Graph, with optional opt-in email drafting/sending.

environment_variables.name: M365_CLIENT_ID
environment_variables.description: Microsoft Entra application (client) ID used for device-code login.

environment_variables.name: M365_TENANT_ID
environment_variables.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Use common for multi-tenant or personal Microsoft accounts.

environment_variables.name: M365_AUTO_OPEN_BROWSER
environment_variables.description: Whether begin_auth should attempt to open the Microsoft login page automatically.

environment_variables.name: M365_OCR_LANGS
environment_variables.description: Tesseract language codes for OCR of scanned PDFs, joined by + (default vie+eng). Language data is downloaded once and cached in the app data dir.

environment_variables.name: M365_ENABLE_SEND
environment_variables.description: Set to true to enable the send_outlook_email tool (drafts only; requests Mail.ReadWrite). Default false = read-only.

environment_variables.name: M365_ALLOW_SEND_NOW
environment_variables.description: Set to true to allow sending immediately (requests Mail.Send). Requires M365_ENABLE_SEND. Default false.

environment_variables.name: M365_SEND_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environment_variables.description: Optional comma-separated recipient domain allowlist. Empty = any recipient.

environment_variables.name: M365_SEND_ALLOWED_DIRS
environment_variables.description: OS-path-separated folders local attachments may come from. Empty = local file attachments disabled.
